clips.title: This Is One of the Last Chances Any of Us Have to Get Ahead

segments.why: HOOK + thesis, cold open on 'I do think this is going to be one of the last opportunities that any of us have to actually get ahead': AI exploding at an exponential level, so many jobs taken away, everything so goddamn cheap, 'you got to buy into those assets right now before all this happens'. Starts after the 'But'; the bull-run/dump timeline talk before it (281-295) is left out on purpose.

The picture that makes it real: 'There's one robot in your house' and you don't need a roofer, a plumber, an electrician, a carpenter, a security guard, 'you don't need anything', 'that's coming within just a couple of years, man'. Ends on 'man', before the third-party video is un-paused.

The instruction to close on: 'stop eating out, stop spending extra money, buy those assets, you're here for crypto, right? So buy that crypto'. Ends before 'maybe diversify a little bit' (gold / real-estate aside).
